requests.reply: {"translations": ["A rainy port town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop.", "Kaoru-senpai, this is the scene. The door was still locked."]}
{"translations": ["Hmm. Was the only thing stolen a single pocket watch?"]}
{"translations": ["The shopkeeper, the elderly Takanashi, is staring at the floor while sitting in his chair."]}
{"translations": ["You've arrived, detectives. Let me tell you one thing beforehand: don't touch anything without permission.", "Yes, Inspector. We'll be careful."]}
{"translations": ["Stop calling me Inspector. Akira is fine. Especially in front of Takanashi-san"]}
{"translations": ["Understood, Akira-san"]}
{"translations": ["Old man Takanashi slowly raised his face."]}
{"translations": ["Akira folded his umbrella and wiped the droplets off the floor.", "Akira-san, please leave your umbrella here"]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, who did you ask to look after the office?"]}
{"translations": ["I'm Nagi. I'm still an eighteen-year-old girl, but I'm reliable. Please don't worry, Akira-san."]}
{"translations": ["That helps. They handle everything from answering the phone to organizing documents."]}
{"translations": ["Chatting comes later. First, we will begin the interrogation.", "Akira-san, could we hear from Takanashi-san first?"]}
{"translations": ["The old man replied in a trembling voice that he closed the shop at nine last night."]}
{"translations": ["For many years now, my grandfather has done nothing but polish that watch."]}
{"translations": ["It seems Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling the whole time."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, how do you see these footprints?", "Akira-san, these do not belong to the culprit. The shoes are too large."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru's observational skills are reliable. He's still a newcomer, but he's second to none"]}
{"translations": ["Kaoru took off her glasses and slowly pressed the inner corners of her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["That watch is also a memento from my mother ▼", "Nagi came rushing in, clutching a wet umbrella."]}
{"translations": ["Out of breath, I delivered the phone message."]}
{"translations": ["Akira-san, the forensics results are in. I will share them with my senior immediately."]}
{"translations": ["Let's listen. ...Ho. The culprit is inside the shop, aren't they?"]}
{"translations": ["Old man Takanashi's hands trembled slightly.", "Outside the window, the rain grew significantly stronger."]}
